reply.text:
I can't give you a dose for BPC-157, or for any peptide. Amounts for that kind of thing are for a doctor. BPC-157 is also not an approved medication, and the research on it in people is thin, so a doctor is the right person to ask about whether it makes sense for you at all.

If "recovery" means you're recovering from an injury or something that hurts, that is one for a doctor or physio, and I'll train around whatever they clear. On the training side I'm happy to dig into sleep, eating enough protein, how your weekly volume is spread out, or whether a deload is due.
